en.focusLock.form.jumuahDurationHint: Fridays only. Counted from your home Masjid's Jumu'ah time when it has one, otherwise from the Dhuhr Adhan.
en.focusLock.form.weekendHint: Skip your weekend days. Your Jumu'ah window still runs on Friday. The days start from your region's weekend; change them below.
en.focusLock.form.modeHint.gentleIos: Tap “I'll pray now” on the block screen to unlock. On iPhone and iPad one tap is enough (no press-and-hold).
